Selective dark outline, restrained highlights. Entire ears, hands and feet inside the canvas with transparent margin, character approximately 56 pixels tall.
One character only, transparent background. No scene, floor, ground shadow, text, weapon, cape, extra props, smooth gradients, antialiasing or blur.
